newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open morning session lower.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open morning session lower.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened lower on Tuesday after posting hefty losses on Monday.
Brokers said stock market participants were likely to stay glued to the sidelines, waiting for key Japanese economic indicators due out later this week, but that losses should be limited.
At 0007 GMT, the market's benchmark Nikkei 225 average was down 55.77 points, or 0.27 percent at 20,827.97. Its September futures were down 20 points at 20,890.
"There is buying interest in the Nikkei average at the 20,400 to 20,500 level and the bottom should be limited," a broker at Daiwa Securities said.
Brokers said trade would be meagre, after turnover volume hit a yearly low of 211.66 million shares on Monday.
"The environment hasn't changed much since yesterday, so trade will have a hard time picking up," one broker said.
